## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature request.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (clean-up or architectural improvement without behavior changes)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (adding missing tests or fixing tests)

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project standards and guidelines
- [ ] TypeScript check passes (`bun run typecheck`)
- [ ] Linter passes with 0 warnings (`bun run lint`)
- [ ] All unit and backend tests pass (`bun run test`)
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated
- [ ] Does not leak sensitive tokens, keys, or credentials
